FULL TEXT:
High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 07/09/2026
N O T I C E
HCG- 04/2026
It is hereby notified for the information of all the Stake Holders
that, the Cause List would be prepared 24 hours prior. Accordingly, the
Cause List for 10/09/2026 would be generated on 09/09/2026, the
Cause List for 11/09/2026 would be generated on 10/09/2026, and so
on, till the Cause List for 18/09/2026. The Cause List for 21/09/2026
would be generated on 18/09/2026 and the Cause List for 22/09/2026
would be generated on 19/09/2026. Thereafter, the existing practice of
generating the Cause list 48 hours in advance shall be restored.
By Order of The Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Date: 07/09/2026 Registrar (Judicial)
